subject: ACME Analytics AWS offer: onboarding content + co-sell playbook
messages:
From: Elaine Zhou <elaine@acme-analytics.com>
To: alex_martinez@redwood.com
Cc: AWS Partner Team <aws-partner-team@amazon.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T16:15:00Z
Subject: New AWS offer onboarding — assets + placement questions

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the intro call earlier — excited to get our ACME Analytics offering live on AWS Marketplace with Redwood as the inference runtime. Attached is a one-pager and logo pack to start. A few quick questions as we prepare listing copy: 

- Can you confirm the recommended hero one-liner length for the Marketplace tile? Any hard character limit we should target?
- For the technical bullets, is it better to prioritize latency/cost numbers or integration benefits (S3, VPC, KMS)?
- We have a co-sell interest — does Redwood handle the partner registration on our behalf, or should we loop the AWS Partner team now?

We'd like to aim for a soft-launch week of Nov 8 if possible. Sharing the one-pager and logo pack as attachments: acme-product-sheet.pdf, acme-logo-pack.zip.

Can you confirm next steps and who from Redwood will own the copy review round?

Best,
Elaine
Elaine Zhou
Head of Partnerships | ACME Analytics
elaine@acme-analytics.com
+1 415-555-0199
From: alex_martinez@redwood.com
To: Elaine Zhou <elaine@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, AWS Partner Team <aws-partner-team@amazon.com>
Date: 2026-10-21T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: New AWS offer onboarding — assets + placement questions

Hi Elaine — great to meet earlier. Thanks for sending the assets. Quick responses inline and next steps below.

- Hero one-liner: AWS tile UI shows ~140 characters before truncation; we recommend 100–120 chars to be safe across regions. Aim for a single-sentence benefit statement (what it does + for whom).
- Technical bullets: lead with the top customer-facing differentiator (e.g., "sub-second inference for multi-turn prompts") then include a short second bullet on integration (VPC/KMS) and a third on unit economics (typical throughput/cost). That ordering works well for field conversions.
- Co-sell: Redwood will coordinate the co-sell assets, but the AWS Partner team needs to approve the marketing claim and register the offer. I'll loop Marissa for co-sell enablement and Jonas for listing entitlements.

Next steps (my recommended timeline):
1) Redwood to provide an AWS listing copy template (attached).
2) ACME to supply 1–2 hero options + 3 technical bullets + 3 customer use cases by Oct 27.
3) Internal review @ Redwood (copy + compliance) Oct 28–30.
4) Submit to AWS Partner team Nov 1 for approval.

Attaching: redwood_aws_listing_template.docx (copy template + metadata checklist).

I'll start the copy pass and assign owners. Who on your side will be primary for legal review?

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Principal Partner Manager | Redwood Inference
alex_martinez@redwood.com
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: alex_martinez@redwood.com, Elaine Zhou <elaine@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-22T17:03:00Z
Subject: Re: New AWS offer onboarding — assets + placement questions

Thanks Alex / Elaine — quick copy notes after skimming the one-pager and the template. I did a short pass in-line below (quoted):

> "ACME Analytics accelerates ML-driven search for e-commerce"

- Suggest reframing to: "ACME Analytics: real-time product search with contextual relevance" (keeps benefit and adds product domain).

> Technical bullets (ACME original): "Low latency. Easy S3 ingestion. Secure. Low cost."

- Recommend tight bullets with metrics where possible:
  • "Sub-200ms median latency for 512-token queries (on rtx-aX)"
  • "S3-native connector for incremental corpus updates"
  • "VPC and KMS support for customer-managed keys"

Also: avoid using the word "secure" alone; pair it with the mechanism (e.g., KMS, VPC).

Jonas — can you confirm whether we should include a "supported instance types" footnote in the listing or keep that detail in the AMI/AMI notes?

Kimberly Park
Senior Content Manager | Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: alex_martinez@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, Elaine Zhou <elaine@acme-analytics.com>

Adding co-sell playbook items and a quick enablement ask:

- Redwood will prepare a 1-pager "co-sell kit" (email templates + battlecards + demo notes). ETA for our kit: Nov 3.
- For AWS approval: we need the final hero line + 3 bullets and the AMI/kernel notes by Nov 1 to make the submission date Alex proposed.

Attaching internal reference: HubSpot deal link (see related_links). I'll also open a HubSpot co-sell play for ACME and assign outreach tasks to field reps.
